observations: Changed AOT and pre-fix AOT both fail before slider input with RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded.
Changed AOT fails over HTTPS as well as localhost HTTP. This comparison does not isolate the underlying engine/runtime cause.

Changed Non-AOT reached main-runtime creation, then stopped emitting startup heartbeat. It did not reach the blur page during approximately 72 seconds of foreground HTTP observation or approximately 67 seconds of foreground HTTPS observation. The pages were then navigated away from; an indefinitely stalled startup has not been proven.
The bootstrap dataset can say started while dorotiRendererError records a failed raster runtime and the root is absent. Started alone does not qualify a working renderer.
limitations: No mode completed, so this is a startup result, not a PASS or FAIL of sustained blur rendering.
This is not evidence that the startup failure has the same cause as the physical iOS 26.6.1 slider/input freeze or WebContent highwater termination.
Non-AOT is a Release build with RunAOTCompilation=false; an SDK hot-reload Debug session was not tested.
Simulator results do not qualify physical iOS 27 memory or GPU behavior.

diagnosis.startupFailure: Captured Worker error stack shows recursive Element.inflateWidget/updateChild, ComponentElement.mount/performRebuild and StatefulElement._firstBuild exhausting the Safari Worker stack before blur starts
diagnosis.cacheFailure: An interpreted publish reused the stripped Sample2 WebCIL from AOT; the single-worker comparison asserted NIY in the empty Program constructor. Regeneration restores its full constructor IL. Cache regeneration alone does not avoid full-AOT recursive mount overflow.
